scenes.title: $100 A MONTH
scenes.say: A hundred dollars a month for thirty years. You pay in thirty-six thousand. So why do you get back eighty-three thousand?

scenes.title: Interest earns interest
scenes.say: Interest earns interest. A thousand at five percent adds fifty, then fifty-two, then fifty-five.

scenes.label: OF THE $83K IS INTEREST. ONLY $3.5K CAME IN THE FIRST 10 YEARS
scenes.say: Ten years in, interest is just thirty-five hundred. At thirty years it's forty-seven thousand. Time does the work.

scenes.title: WOULD YOU START?
scenes.say: That's a five percent example, not a promise. Real rates vary. Would you start today? Comment yes or no.
